description: Implementation of WifiManagerState class handling WiFi state management, including caching, retrieving current state, connected SSID, enabling/disabling WiFi, and supported security modes.

classes.name: WifiManagerState
classes.description: Manages WiFi state, including caching, querying current state, connected SSID, enabling/disabling WiFi, and supported security modes.

methods.name: setWifiStateCache
methods.description: Sets the WiFi state cache and whether to use it.

methods.name: getCurrentState
methods.description: Retrieves the current WiFi state, using cache if enabled.

methods.name: getConnectedSSID
methods.description: Gets the SSID and related info of the currently connected WiFi network.

methods.name: setEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables the WiFi interface.

methods.name: getSupportedSecurityModes
methods.description: Returns the list of supported WiFi security modes.
